components.name: Continuation cue
components.description: 38px cue within current compact conversation; continuous pulse while visible, disabled by reduced motion.
components.html: <button class="ds-down" aria-label="Show the next messages" aria-expanded="false"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-down{width:38px;height:38px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--button);color:var(--button-ink);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 3px 9px #18282212;animation:ds-pulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;cursor:pointer}.ds-down svg{width:24px;height:24px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.7}.ds-down:hover{background:var(--button);filter:brightness(1.06)}.ds-down:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:4px}@keyframes ds-pulse{0%,100%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1);box-shadow:0 3px 8px #18282224}50%{opacity:.78;transform:translateY(3px) scale(1.08);box-shadow:0 6px 14px #18282235}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-down{animation:none}}

components.html:
Your data

Your messaging archive stays on your computer. Content passed to your agent follows its model settings.

narrative.overview:
The current landing keeps the Memory heading, purple/green palette and Unbounded/Onest pairing, with tighter conversation and section density. Content, proximity and quiet horizontal rules join the page; separate frames belong to useful controls and conversation details rather than every section.

The owner selected `/landing-editorial` on 2026-10-09 as the canonical composition: open role lists, simple outcomes and compact bubbles. Workspace (role rail/unframed agent prose) and folds (expandable role rows/continuous conversation) remain alternatives in the studio and library. Four scenarios and three complete exchanges remain available in each conversation. Earlier designs are preserved references, not new heading or brand authority.
keyCharacteristics: Compact conversation text and bounded scrolling.
Three uses followed by concise question/result outcomes.
Quiet rules with restrained functional frames.
Trust and an editable estimate lead to setup.

rules.name: The Complete Conversation Rule
rules.body: Reduce padding and initial viewport height without removing message content, source evidence or either follow-up.

rules.name: The Purposeful Frame Rule
rules.body: Use proximity and quiet rules to join sections; reserve rounded surfaces for conversation, commands and functional controls.

rules.name: The Six Capabilities Rule
rules.body: Retain six capabilities for every role: three visible plus three disclosed in editorial, six in the workspace panel, and six inside each fold.

dos: Do preserve the Memory heading and existing purple-green identity.
Do retain complete three-turn conversations within the compact viewport.
Do place trust before the unchanged calculator and setup.
Do preserve bot-history limits, owner decisions and accurate model-processing wording.
donts: Don’t promote older heading, radius or section scales into the current compact composition.
Don’t claim agent processing is necessarily local.
Don’t replace full-width catalogue sections with half-width previews.
